name: EleutherAI
summary: Grassroots-turned-nonprofit research institute focused on open large-scale models, datasets, interpretability and evaluation. It grew out of a Discord community and is known for the GPT-Neo/GPT-NeoX/Pythia model families and The Pile.

notable_releases.name: gpt-neox
notable_releases.note: Training library behind GPT-NeoX-20B and Pythia

openness: Models under Apache-2.0, code on GitHub, datasets such as The Pile released publicly.

contributions.title: Open LLMs
contributions.note: Released GPT-Neo, GPT-J and GPT-NeoX-20B as early open alternatives to GPT-3.

contributions.title: Pythia suite
contributions.note: Checkpointed models for studying training dynamics and scaling.

contributions.title: Evaluation harness
contributions.note: Maintains lm-evaluation-harness used across the field.

contributions.title: Datasets
contributions.note: Built The Pile, a large open text corpus.

contributions.title: Interpretability
contributions.note: Runs open interpretability research such as sparse autoencoders.

hf_highlights.note: Smallest-scale member of the Pythia suite

papers.title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing Large Language Models Across Training and Scaling

The Pile: An 800GB Dataset of Diverse Text for Language Modeling

name: Nous Research
summary: AI research collective turned company that trains and releases open post-trained models, notably the Hermes family, and works on decentralised training and agent tooling.
openness: Open-weight models and permissively licensed code on Hugging Face and GitHub.

contributions.title: Hermes models
contributions.note: Fine-tuned open models with strong steerability and tool use.

name: Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
summary: Seattle-based nonprofit research institute building fully open language models (OLMo), datasets (Dolma), post-training recipes (Tulu) and science and vision tools.

notable_releases.name: OLMo
notable_releases.note: Fully open LLM code, data and checkpoints

openness: Releases weights, training code and data, mostly under Apache-2.0.

name: Hugging Face
summary: Company and hub for open machine learning, hosting models, datasets and demos and maintaining widely used libraries such as Transformers and Diffusers. Also trains open models and datasets such as SmolLM and FineWeb.
openness: Most libraries under Apache-2.0; hosts open models and datasets.

contributions.title: Hub
contributions.note: Central open platform for models and datasets.

contributions.note: De facto library for open model implementations.

name: Mozilla.ai
summary: Public benefit company founded by Mozilla (a subsidiary of the Mozilla Foundation) building open-source tools for trustworthy, user-controlled AI such as llamafile, any-llm and any-agent.
openness: Open-source code, mostly permissive licences; affiliated with the Mozilla Foundation.

contributions.title: llamafile
contributions.note: Makes running LLMs locally a single executable.

contributions.title: Evaluation tooling

summary: AI cloud company whose research arm releases open datasets, models and methods, including RedPajama data and models and Mixture-of-Agents.
